memories.content: Dmytro is a warehouse supervisor at the company. He is aware of the newly posted operations-manager role and is considering whether to apply. He has his own career aspirations, concerns about qualifications, and personal circumstances that may influence his decision.

The company has posted an operations-manager role. Applications close in three weeks from the simulation start time, i.e., by 2026-09-07T17:00:00+02:00. Dmytro is eligible to apply as an internal candidate. The application process is known to employees.
